scripts.build: npm run decks && BASE="${BASE:-/}" && npx slidev build slides.md --base "$BASE" --out dist && npx slidev build enunciados.md --base "${BASE}enunciados/" --out dist/enunciados && npx slidev build hallazgos.md --base "${BASE}hallazgos/" --out dist/hallazgos
scripts.export: npm run decks && slidev export slides.md --per-slide --wait 2500 --timeout 300000 --output 2027-usap-informativa.pdf && slidev export enunciados.md --per-slide --wait 2500 --timeout 300000 --output 2027-usap-enunciados.pdf && slidev export hallazgos.md --per-slide --wait 2500 --timeout 300000 --output 2027-usap-hallazgos.pdf
scripts.publish: git add -A && git commit -m "update deck" ; git push origin main
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx serve dist -l 4173
